title: Email/query date filter silently skips RFC-2822 dates
description: email/query.rs after/before filters call parse_rfc3339_timestamp on e.date, but OverviewRecord.date stores RFC 2822 dates from NNTP headers. parse_rfc3339_timestamp uses chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339 which returns Err for RFC 2822 format. When parsing fails, the retain predicate uses map_or(true, ...) — meaning articles with unparseable dates PASS the filter unconditionally. All real NNTP articles have RFC 2822 dates; the after/before filter returns wrong results (ignores the date constraint) for 100% of actual data.
